source: lean-categories main, export SNAP/lean-categories; every `normalized_registry` row of every module (import closure of LeanCategories.All)
criterion: Edge = (a) a functor row with `structural := true` (FunctorEntry.structural, Catalogue/Registry/Entry.lean:505-520), or (b) the forgetful functor total(c) -> host(c) of a registered classifier c, present when a named category row has expression `.classifierTotal c` (SemanticState.structuralEdges, Catalogue/Registry/Semantic.lean:1681-1693), or (c) the derived image k(U) : k(A) -> k(B) of a structural edge U under a unary constructor k with a registered action on functors (SemanticState.edgesFrom, Semantic.lean:1698-1714; k is ctor.arrow or ctor.core, Catalogue/Semantics/ConstructorRegistration.lean:86-99). Nodes are category expressions compared by exact syntax (CategoryExpr.syntacticEq, Catalogue/Syntax.lean:334-352). layer = number of edges of the longest chain to `cat.sets`, with the outgoing edges of `cat.sets` cut; null = `cat.sets` is not reached.
